test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 23

questions.question: Three solid cubes, each of edge 10 cm, are joined to form a single cuboid. How many cubes of edge 2 cm are formed from this cuboid?
In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rice costing ₹240 and ₹152 per kg, respectively, to get a mixture of rice worth ₹219 per kg?3343
The greatest number, which divides 2031 and 1697 to leave 1 and 2 respectively as remainders, is:
A and B working together can do a piece of work in 16 days. B alone can do the same work in 80 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do the same work?
A bus is moving at a speed of 38 km/hr. If its speed is reduced by 70%, the new speed of the bus (in km/hr) will be:
A vendor sold 28 chocolates for a rupee, thereby gaining 50%. How many chocolates did he buy for a rupee?
A man receives ₹6,925 per month as salary. He saves 24% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
Find the simple interest (in ₹), if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 9.5 years at 8% per annum rate of interest.

A and B can complete a piece of work in 16 days and 16 days, respectively. They started doing the work together, but after 2 days B had to leave, and A completed the remaining work alone. The remaining work was completed in _________ days.
The value of 'x' in the proportion equation 35 : 25 :: 28 : x is:

One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 57 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 12 km/hr and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 15 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to 1 decimal place) for the entire journey is:
1% of 37% of a number is what percentage of that number?

एक पन्ना-रत्न की कीमत उसके भार के वर्ग के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है। जब पन्ना-रत्न को बलपूर्वक एक आभूषण में फिट किया जाता है, तो वह चार टुकड़ो में टूट जाता है, जिनके भार 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 के अनुपात में हैं। यदि रत्न के कुल मूल्य में ₹1,40,000 की हानि होती है, तो पन्ना-रत्न का वास्तविक मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

Rohit deposited a certain sum of money at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. At the end of 2 years, he received a total amount of ₹66,420. What was the sum of money (in ₹) deposited by Rohit?
Manjit has borrowed an amount of ₹3,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 5% per annum after 3 years?
The population of a town increases every year by 8%. If its present population is 78,125, then after 3 years it will be:
A shopkeeper marks his chairs 22.5% above the cost price and allows a 12% discount for cash purchases. Find the shopkeeper’s profit percentage if he sells for cash.
A trader purchased 61 light bulbs for ₹61. During transit, 14 bulbs were damaged. He sold the remaining bulbs at ₹2.10 each. What was his profit?
The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 11 and 330, respectively. If one of the numbers is 165, then find the other one.
